Export world

Put <name>.json into the worlds/ folder of the WebDriveSim repository, then run ros2 launch webdrivesim_bringup sim.launch.py world:=<name>.json. The package also has world.yaml (same content for your nodes), road.xodr (OpenDRIVE 1.6 for CARLA, RoadRunner, esmini, MATLAB) and a README.
